problem.title: Warehouse Inventory Control API
problem.description: Build a PostgreSQL REST API for warehouse inventory. Implement POST /products to create products with sku, name, and stock. Implement GET /products/:id to fetch a product by id. Implement PATCH /products/:id/stock to update stock. Implement GET /products/low-stock/:threshold to list products where stock is less than or equal to threshold. Return 404 if product is not found.
